title: PVFormer: Proper Velocity Transformer for Stable and Scalable Hyperbolic Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.30785v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hyperbolic representations have shown remarkable success on hierarchical and tree-like data, and Transformers have become a central architecture for representation learning. However, a principled construction of hyperbolic Transformers remains challenging because the self-attention layer decomposes into three coupled primitives, transformation, similarity, and aggregation, that should all respect the underlying geometry. Existing hyperbolic Transformer designs are typically built in the Poincar\'e or Lorentz models, where bounded domains, time-like constraints, tangent-space detours, or projection steps make it difficult to keep the full block intrinsic and scalable. To address this gap, we propose PVFormer, to the best of our knowledge, the first Transformer architecture that operates natively in proper velocity (PV) space. translated_title: PVFormer：用于稳定且可扩展的双曲表示学习的固有速度Transformer
translated_abstract: 双曲表示在层次化与树状数据上已展现出卓越的成功，而Transformer已成为表示学习的核心架构。然而，如何以原理性的方式构建双曲Transformer仍然具有挑战性，因为自注意力层可分解为三个相互耦合的基本操作——变换、相似度计算与聚合——它们都应当遵循底层的几何结构。现有的双曲Transformer设计通常建立在庞加莱模型或洛伦兹模型之上，其中有界域、类时约束、切空间绕行或投影步骤使得整个模块难以保持内在性和可扩展性。为填补这一空白，我们提出了PVFormer，据我们所知，这是首个在固有速度空间中原生运行的Transformer架构。固有速度模型为双曲几何提供了一种无约束的表示，PVFormer利用了……
tldr: 提出PVFormer——首个在无约束的固有速度（PV）空间中原生运行的双曲Transformer架构，实现了稳定且可扩展的双曲表示学习。
en_tdlr: PVFormer is proposed as the first Transformer architecture that natively operates in unconstrained proper velocity space, enabling stable and scalable hyperbolic representation learning.
